# Source

The `src` layer of Docturnal contains various modules that support different aspects of the project, including accuracy checks, line analysis, file processing, and language detection.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for the core functionality of Docturnal, ensuring that code changes are accurately analyzed, processed, and reported.

## Responsibilities

- Exports functions for accuracy checks and comment parsing.
- Analyzes lines and tokenizes them.
- Applies results and merges state.
- Manages changes and documentation.
- The comment engine.
- Reads the action inputs from INPUT_* environment variables and validates them.
- Layer configuration and file scanning.
- The docs generator for the layer docs in docs/.
- Manages folder structures and purposes.
- Git operations for the Action.
- Keeps a layer doc's prose to what its material says.
- Orders existing code by importance.
- Installs the Ollama release.
- The language table, plus the rules that decide whether a file is commented, only read for docs, or skipped.
- Architecture layers grounded in the project's real folders.
- Generated text normalization.
- Action entry point.
- Picks the Ollama models for this run.
- Minimal client for the Ollama server on the runner.
- Which comments in a file Docturnal wrote itself.
- The pre-check, run before models are selected or Ollama is installed.
- The work of processing comments and documents.
- Analyzes and verifies Python source for Docturnal.
- Runs src/python-helper.py with python3 to analyze and verify Python source.
- The repository's README.md, the main document.
- Builds .docturnal/last-run.md, which the GitHub App uses as the pull request description.
- A deterministic check for comments that only restate the code under them.
- Docturnal reads and writes a few paths by name: README.md, docs/, .docturnal/, and project files such as package.json.
- Manages application state and file paths.
- Analyzes file structures and comments.
- Checks each pulled model against pins/models.json before any code reaches it.
- Proves that inserting comments did not change the program.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/accuracy.js`](../src/accuracy.js) | Exports functions for accuracy checks and comment parsing. | `ACCURACY_SCHEMA`, `attachedCode`, `buildAccuracyMessages`, `codeUnder`, `parseVerdicts` |
| [`src/analyze.js`](../src/analyze.js) | Analyzes lines and tokenizes them. | `analyzeLines`, `lineStarts`, `matchToken`, `splitLines`, `lineIndexAt`, `baseInfo` |
| [`src/apply.js`](../src/apply.js) | Applies results and merges state. | `applyRun` |
| [`src/changes.js`](../src/changes.js) | Manages changes and documentation. | `docExists`, `docsDone`, `findChanges`, `ignoreHash`, `needsComments`, `nothingToCover` |
| [`src/comments.js`](../src/comments.js) | The comment engine. | `CATEGORY`, `LEVELS`, `RESPONSE_SCHEMA`, `applyProposals`, `buildWindows`, `checkComments` |
| [`src/config.js`](../src/config.js) | Reads the action inputs from INPUT_* environment variables and validates them. | `COMMENT_LEVELS`, `EXISTING_CODE`, `ConfigError`, `readConfig`, `readInput`, `readList` |
| [`src/configuration.js`](../src/configuration.js) | Layer configuration and file scanning. | `actionInputs`, `configurationSection`, `layerConfiguration`, `scanFile`, `withoutComments`, `scanScript` |
| [`src/docs.js`](../src/docs.js) | The docs generator for the layer docs in docs/. | `DOC_PROMPT_CHARS`, `MARKER`, `README_GENERATED`, `README_SECTIONS`, `STYLE_RULES`, `arrangeSections` |
| [`src/folders.js`](../src/folders.js) | Manages folder structures and purposes. | `FOLDER_SCHEMA`, `MAX_FILES_PER_CALL`, `callLabel`, `callTokens`, `dirOf`, `digestLine` |
| [`src/git.js`](../src/git.js) | Git operations for the Action. | `BaseBranchError`, `BOT_EMAIL`, `BOT_NAME`, `defaultBranch`, `IGNORE_FILE`, `UPDATE_BRANCH` |
| [`src/grounding.js`](../src/grounding.js) | Keeps a layer doc's prose to what its material says. | `TERMS_PER_MISSING`, `MIN_OVERVIEW_WORDS`, `folderOverview`, `groundSection`, `grounded`, `layerMaterial` |
| [`src/importance.js`](../src/importance.js) | Orders existing code by importance. | `complexity`, `importSpecifiers`, `isEntryPoint`, `packageEntries`, `rankFiles`, `resolveImport` |
| [`src/install-ollama.js`](../src/install-ollama.js) | Installs the Ollama release. | `InstallError`, `checkInstall`, `installOllama`, `pinnedArchive`, `readPins`, `download` |
| [`src/languages.js`](../src/languages.js) | The language table, plus the rules that decide whether a file is commented, only read for docs, or skipped. | `LANGUAGES`, `LEXER_TOKENS`, `LOCKFILES`, `MAX_FILE_BYTES`, `SKIP_DIRS`, `classifyFile` |
| [`src/layers.js`](../src/layers.js) | Architecture layers grounded in the project's real folders. | `GENERIC_NAMES`, `LAYERS_SCHEMA`, `MAX_LAYERS`, `copiesPurpose`, `folderName`, `groupFiles` |
| [`src/links.js`](../src/links.js) | Generated text normalization. | `cleanProseLine`, `forgetKnownUrls`, `hasUnknownUrl`, `keepCodeLine`, `knownUrls`, `normalizeUrl` |
| [`src/main.js`](../src/main.js) | Action entry point. | `TIMEOUT_MARGIN_MINUTES`, `run`, `resolveModels`, `backlogRanker`, `makePlan` |
| [`src/models.js`](../src/models.js) | Picks the Ollama models for this run. | `COMMENT_MODEL`, `DOCS_MODEL`, `FALLBACK_DOCS_MODEL`, `DOCS_MODEL_MIN_GIB`, `parseMemTotal`, `readTotalMemory` |
| [`src/ollama.js`](../src/ollama.js) | Minimal client for the Ollama server on the runner. | `DEFAULT_HOST`, `baseUrl`, `chat`, `describeError`, `loggedChat`, `request` |
| [`src/owned.js`](../src/owned.js) | Which comments in a file Docturnal wrote itself. | `anchorHash`, `cleanRecords`, `findOwned`, `recordFor`, `isRecord` |
| [`src/precheck.js`](../src/precheck.js) | The pre-check, run before models are selected or Ollama is installed. | `precheck`, `plural`, `writeOutputs` |
| [`src/process.js`](../src/process.js) | The work of processing comments and documents. | `DOCS_PASS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `DOCS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `deadlines`, `processItems` |
| [`src/python-helper.py`](../src/python-helper.py) | Analyzes and verifies Python source for Docturnal. | `analyze`, `dump`, `env_names`, `verify`, `main`, `_dotted` |
| [`src/python.js`](../src/python.js) | Runs src/python-helper.py with python3 to analyze and verify Python source. | `analyzePython`, `findPython`, `pythonEnvNames`, `verifyPython`, `runHelper` |
| [`src/readme.js`](../src/readme.js) | The repository's README.md, the main document. | `readmeIsPlain`, `proseParagraphs`, `readmePrompt`, `MAINTAINED`, `README_PATH`, `README_STATE_PATH` |
| [`src/report.js`](../src/report.js) | Builds .docturnal/last-run.md, which the GitHub App uses as the pull request description. | `DOCS_TITLE`, `UPDATE_TITLE`, `buildReport`, `code`, `plainText`, `progressLines` |
| [`src/restates.js`](../src/restates.js) | A deterministic check for comments that only restate the code under them. | `RESTATES_AT`, `restatement`, `restates`, `stem`, `words` |
| [`src/safe-path.js`](../src/safe-path.js) | Docturnal reads and writes a few paths by name: README.md, docs/, .docturnal/, and project files such as package.json. | `LinkError`, `isPlainPath`, `requirePlainPath` |
| [`src/state.js`](../src/state.js) | Manages application state and file paths. | `LAST_RUN_PATH`, `STATE_PATH`, `emptyPending`, `emptyState`, `hashContent`, `readState` |
| [`src/structure.js`](../src/structure.js) | Analyzes file structures and comments. | `commentPurpose`, `fileStructure`, `leadingComment`, `structuralSummary`, `symbolsOf`, `basename` |
| [`src/verify-models.js`](../src/verify-models.js) | Checks each pulled model against pins/models.json before any code reaches it. | `ModelDigestError`, `compareBlobs`, `readPins`, `referencedDigests`, `verifyFiles`, `verifyModels` |
| [`src/verify.js`](../src/verify.js) | Proves that inserting comments did not change the program. | `rebuildsOriginal`, `verifyCandidates`, `stripBom`, `rawLines`, `transpile`, `shape` |

## How it works

- **accuracy.js**: Exports functions for performing accuracy checks on code changes.
- **apply.js**: Applies the results of the analysis and merges them into the codebase.
- **config.js**: Reads the action inputs and configurations for the project.
- **docs.js**: Generates documentation for the project.
- **git.js**: Provides Git operations for the project, such as committing and pushing changes.
- **grounding.js**: Keeps a layer doc's prose grounded and accurate.
- **importance.js**: Orders existing code by its importance for the project.
- **layers.js**: Defines the architecture layers of the project.
- **links.js**: Generates text links for documentation and references.
- **models.js**: Selects the appropriate Ollama models for processing.
- **ollama.js**: A minimal client

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `BASE_BRANCH`, `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, `GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `GITHUB_PATH`, `GITHUB_REF_NAME`, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `OLLAMA_DIR`, `OLLAMA_HOST`, `OLLAMA_MODELS`, `OLLAMA_VERSION`, `PUSH`, `RUNNER_TEMP`.
- Action inputs: `backlog-batch-size`, `comment-level`, `context-tokens`, `docs-dir`, `docs-model`, `exclude`, `existing-code`, `extensions`, `job-timeout-minutes`, `model`, `path`, `time-budget-minutes`.
- Configuration files: `action.yml`, `pins/models.json`, `pins/ollama.json`.

## Related layers

- [Project README](../README.md): the overview of the whole project and every layer.
- [App Management](app-management.md): Handles app registration, installation updates, session tokens, and GitHub API versions.
- [Release Management](release-management.md): Manages archive hashes, model digests, and checksums for Ollama releases.
- [Tests](tests.md): This folder contains test files that define and evaluate various aspects of the project, including action steps, checks, comments, configurations, and end-to-end tests.
